notes.title: Mind Scanners turns 1! 🥳 Let's celebrate
notes.content:
Happy Birthday, Mind Scanners!

The Structure turns 1  this Friday and we prepared some really cool things for you.
It has been a full year since we released Mind Scanners and thanks to you it has been a wild ride.
Being a political game with links to psychiatry, society & a very dystopian future, it sparked a lot of needed conversation around all these topics. 

Games can help us to reflect ourselves, our environment and the way we interact with each other. If a game is able to make you think, it does something very valuable. 
We talked about favourite devices with you, silly and interesting characters and how you try to solve problems that come up in this dark world. Let's just say the last year was never boring.

Thank you for your reviews (they literally do a lot for us) and the ongoing support!

But what's a party without EVENTS/STUFF/GIFTS?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/11f10560cb227a13111df0fe12c13addd8fbac1e.png40% Discount
This is the lowest discount Mind Scanners had so far, snack it while you can!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/b5c0a9e24715ae7422bc63b8581140e3f84d8852.pngStream & KEYS
YES we want to spend some time with you together in this haunting world, join us today around 6PM BST and grab some keys.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/11f10560cb227a13111df0fe12c13addd8fbac1e.pngDemo
We have our Demo up for you to try the game out if you're not so sure about the purchase yet, jump in and discover some parts of The Structure! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/b5c0a9e24715ae7422bc63b8581140e3f84d8852.pngTrading Cards
The game has COMMUNITY ITEMS now 😎 Emojis, Backgrounds & Trading cards to earn cool badges. The cards also come with neat little device instructions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/d1516b9c5163bac0316e1f71b353d6dfbf7b12ad.gif

Some achievements for the team during the last year
We had a sparkling number of  150.000 PLAYERS across all platforms! 
The game got into GAMEPASS which was huge for us & also launched on NINTENDO SWITCH! 
On top it was NOMINATED IN 5 CATEGORIES and WON BEST NARRATIVE at the Danish Spilprisen Awards & PUBLIC PRIZE at the Strasbourg European Fantastic Film Festival.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/5b7e4547b43832aa6bcc48f1d9ad4249a0b7ecab.png

All that's left to say for us is that we hope you continue enjoying this universe and that being in the shoes of a Mind Scanner will forever be an experience that makes you think and reflect on these very important topics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/667b0e664f6ddc491ac94e54a056f9db7b546ca1.gif

notes.title: Guess the insanity type and win a Mind Scanners game key! 🔑
notes.content:
Greetings, Mind Scanner!

A new patient arrived for you to treat. Find out what insanity type she has and answer in the comments for a chance to get a Mind Scanners game key! 🔑

Who will win? 
We pick a winner randomly from the correct answers. 

Take a look at your glossary, if you are unsure about the types:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/3f59f03ad5f8d919f666cfba9bb1ac54f5d0e284.png
[hr][/hr] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/48fd89502d9acead9de43ae83342274d2954fa8d.png
GET TO WORK, SCANNER.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/ff78e644c1b4676a0721c5b9f8a9c8f5bea1f0df.png

You greet your next patient, Misha Saltcloud, a tailor who works in The Boots. Originally she wanted to become a Marine Biologist after finding and devouring the old transcripts of her grand grand grand mother who worked far away from The Structure as one of the most famous scientists in this field.
She seems to be obsessed with everything sea related and alternates every piece she receives from a customer. Colouring fabrics blue, attaching scales and fins, turning clothing into deep sea creature costumes...
One day, a guard found her painting weird creatures on the walls. The people around her are worried, since she seems to have deeply rooted anger issues, she can't control anymore.
During your Mind Scan, Misha tells you, that she believes she has "sea-genes" that will turn her into a sea creature eventually. Until then, the life ashore makes her miserable.

You know, that The Structure would declare her insane. So you do your job.
What's the insanity type, Scanner?


Comment your insanity type guess 💊
Contest ends in 3 days 📌
We will message the key to an account with a random correct answer 📩

What else can you do?
Click the Wishlist button to support us even more, it's really appreciated! 💖

notes.content: Fixed some UI bugs.

notes.title: More fixes and tweaks
notes.content:
For your convenience:
You can now leave treatment to repack your bag and resume treatment immediately as long as no insanity points have been removed.
Logo video intro can now be skipped on ESC. This is mostly intended for players who can't load the videos for some reason. Skipping the video intro won't make the game load much faster on most systems as the game is already loading in the background while the videos are playing.

Balancing:
Slightly more insanty on hard mode.
ROBOTANY made easier.
Cooldown changes:

Electrigger cooldown now stacks with other cooldowns
ECHOPUNCTURE cooldown now depends on the number of insanity points you remove.
HYPNAMID cooldown slightly increased to not allow back to back uses.


Bugfixes:
Trauma Bomb + Ease Pill
Mouse issues
Text alignment

notes.title: Your Quality of Life has been improved
notes.content:
Small new features to improve the life of any Mind Scanner:

Easy swap and reorder devices in device manager.
A device can no longer be interrupted while it is just about to deliver its effect.
You can now also delete your current profile.

Device changes:

5 new mazes added to MIND MAZE.
LUNA SUCKER made slightly easier.
Improved Russian and Chinese localization for REFLECTOR (word device).

Balance changes: Slightly shorter traveldistances and more available patients at any given time.

Gamebreaking bugs have been fixed:

Mouse issues on a multiple monitor setup.
Better handling of currupted/missing save files.
Game will skip video intro if video can't be played.

Minor bug fixes:

Fixed time pausing exploits with book of Lunacy.
Some missing sprites have been hooked up.
Fixed interaction edgecases of different devices.
UI tweaks.

notes.title: New Difficulty Settings and localization fixes
notes.content:
Hi all! A New patch is now up and apart from some minor bugs, we have now added a difficulty setting!
When you start a new game, you will be now able to select a difficulty setting from the main menu.

If you already have an existing save, you will not be able to change the difficulty setting for that particular playthrough.

Here are some notes on what is different in the different difficulty settings:

 maintenance amount
 starting kapok amount
 symptom points amount
 travel time
 device cost
 auto-balanging thresholds (when will the auto balancer try to make life easier or harder for you)
 the penalty for answering wrong in mind scan is also different: 5/10/15


Best wishes,
Brave At Night & The Outer Zone

notes.title: Mind Scanners: a retro-futuristic management RPG DEMO PITCH
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/9ba913825898081c958715be409489265be4d9bf.png

About the game
Mind Scanners is an experimental, thought provoking management sim that takes place in a metropolitan regime city. Take a role of a Mind Scanner - diagnose and treat the citizens of this dystopian society and decide whether to join the resistance group of Moonrise. 

The Demo
The short 10-20min demo will take you through your first three patients and a selection of treatment devices. You will be able to scan citizens' minds and decipher their personality types as well as choose whether they require treatment. You must remember that each patient is sensitive and there will be consequences for a wrong diagnosis!

We hope you enjoy a taster of the game and we are looking forward to hearing your feedback over at discord.gg/mindscanners 

If you have already played and enjoyed the demo, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to be notified when it releases!

The Team
The team behind Mind Scanners is a small three person studio called The Outer Zone based in Denmark.  They have been working on the game for about year and you will be able to play the full version of the game in early 2021!

Join our community!
Want to come and say hi to the devs?

Discord: discord.gg/mindscanners

Twitter: @outerzonetweets

Publisher: @braveatnight

Email: contact@braveatnight.co.uk

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/3f701123fda12157c8362e92f04f54b8ba5978b1.png
Mind Scanners Live Stream:
Join us for the first public gameplay of Mind Scanners during the Steam Autumn Festival!
We will be hosting a live stream of the first few patients and answering your questions about the game!

Mind Scanners is planned to release in Early 2021, wishlist it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389550/Mind_Scanners/

About Mind Scanners:
Mind Scanners is a retro-futuristic management game in which you diagnose the citizens of a dystopian metropolis. Locate a host of other-worldly characters and use arcade-style treatment devices to help them. Manage your time and resources to keep The Structure in balance. Remember, you take full responsibility for your patients.
